title: Conservative Overlap Fuzzy Rough Sets for Incomplete Data
description:
arXiv:2611.31329v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Attribute reduction in incomplete information systems is difficult because missing values break the equivalence-class structure of rough set theory. We propose the Conservative Overlap Fuzzy Rough Set (COFRS) model. Each object is described by its set of present attributes.
